description_en: Creates a reach plan for re-engaging and recalling churned users based on the parameter settings described in this topic
description_zh: 您可以根据本文提供的参数配置说明，创建触达计划，进行流失用户的触达和召回
kebab_example: aliyun paiplugin create-schedule --end-time 2020-01-01 --execute-time 2020-01-01_12:00:00 --group-id 00000195-03e2-40bd-869d-b71cb302783e --name Growth-2021-0101 --repeat-cycle 0 --repeat-cycle-unit 0 --repeat-times='-1' --sign-name PAI --signature-id 0a54e195-03e2-40bd-869d-b71cb3020000 --template-code SMS_123000 --template-id 0a54e000-03e2-40bd-869d-b71cb3000000 --ai-send-start-date 2020-01-01_12:00:00 --ai-send-end-date 2020-01-01_12:00:00 --payment-type PayAsYouGo --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSchedule

parameters.help_en: The end time for intelligent sending, in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 智能发送结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: ai_send_end_date

parameters.help_en: The start time for intelligent sending, in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 智能发送开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: ai_send_start_date

parameters.help_en:
The execution time (UTC+8):
If left empty, the plan runs immediately.
If an execution time is set, you must also set a repeat cycle (RepeatCycle)
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间 (UTC+8)：
为空则立即执行。
设置执行时间，则需要设置重复周期（RepeatCycle）
parameters.name: execute_time

parameters.help_en: The audience ID. To obtain the audience ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429068.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the reach plan. The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 触达计划名称。长度为2~30个字符，支持字母、数字、汉字和下划线（_）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. If left empty, the default is pay-as-you-go. Valid values:

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
Subscription: subscription
MixPay: combined payment
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型（为空时默认后付费），取值如下：

PayAsYouGo：后付费
Subscription：预付费
MixPay：组合付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: The repeat cycle. The plan runs based on the repeat cycle and repeat cycle unit
parameters.help_zh: 重复周期，按重复周期与重复周期单位执行
parameters.name: repeat_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The repeat cycle unit. If an execution time (ExecuteTime) is specified, the plan runs according to this unit. Valid values:
0: Never (default).
1: Hour.
2: Day.
3: Week.
4: Month
parameters.help_zh:
重复周期单位，若指定执行时间（ExecuteTime），则按重复周期单位执行。
0：从不（默认）。
1：小时。
2：天。
3：周。
4：月
parameters.name: repeat_cycle_unit

parameters.help_en:
The number of repetitions. Valid values:
-1: No end time (default).
0: No repetition.
N: Stop after N repetitions
parameters.help_zh:
重复次数，取值如下：
-1：不设终止时间（默认）。
0：不重复。
N：重复N次后终止
parameters.name: repeat_times

parameters.help_en: The signature name. To obtain the signature name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/413410.html
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称，如何获取签名名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/413410.html
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The signature ID. To obtain the signature ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/413410.html
parameters.name: signature_id

parameters.help_en: The template code. To obtain the template code, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/413414.html
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en: The template ID or specified template code. To obtain the template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/413414.html
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID，或指定模板Code。如何获取模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/413414.html
parameters.name: template_id
